description: Analyze engineering trends, capabilities, complexity, and strategic themes derived from historical engineering work.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(weight), 1) AS average_weight
FROM vw_issue_details
WHERE customer_name IN (${customer:sqlstring})
  AND project_name IN (${project:sqlstring})
  AND status IN (${status:sqlstring})
  AND priority IN (${priority:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(created_date);

spec.description: Shows the average engineering complexity score for the selected issues. Higher values indicate more complex work requiring greater engineering effort.
spec.title: Average Issue Weight

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    issue_key AS "Issue Key",
    title AS "Title",
    customer_name AS "Customer",
    team_name AS "Team",
    priority AS "Priority",
    weight AS "Weight",
    skill_count AS "Skills",
    theme_count AS "Themes",
    issue_url
FROM vw_engineering_intelligence
WHERE customer_name IN (${customer:sqlstring})
  AND project_name IN (${project:sqlstring})
  AND status IN (${status:sqlstring})
  AND priority IN (${priority:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(created_date)
ORDER BY
    weight DESC,
    priority,
    issue_key;

spec.description: Engineering Intelligence provides an executive view of engineering workload, complexity, ownership, and customer urgency. Using engineering issue metadata enriched with technical skills and business themes, this dashboard helps engineering leaders identify complexity hotspots, prioritize work, and better understand how engineering effort is distributed across teams, technologies, and customers.
spec.title: Engineering Intelligence Detail

spec.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM vw_issue_details
WHERE customer_name IN (${customer:sqlstring})
  AND project_name  IN (${project:sqlstring})
  AND status        IN (${status:sqlstring})
  AND priority      IN (${priority:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(created_date);

spec.description: Displays the total number of engineering issues matching the current dashboard filters. This metric provides a quick view of the overall workload being analyzed.
spec.title: Engineering Issues

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    skill_name,
    ROUND(AVG(weight), 2) AS average_weight
FROM vw_issue_skills
WHERE customer_name IN (${customer:sqlstring})
  AND project_name IN (${project:sqlstring})
  AND status IN (${status:sqlstring})
  AND priority IN (${priority:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(created_date)
GROUP BY skill_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT issue_id) >= 2
ORDER BY average_weight DESC;

spec.description: Compares the average complexity of engineering issues associated with each technical skill. Use this visualization to identify technologies that are typically involved in more complex engineering work.
spec.title: Average Issue Weight by Skill

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN priority = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / COUNT(*),
        1
    ) AS high_priority_pct
FROM vw_issue_details
WHERE customer_name IN (${customer:sqlstring})
  AND project_name IN (${project:sqlstring})
  AND status IN (${status:sqlstring})
  AND priority IN (${priority:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(created_date);

spec.description: Displays the percentage of engineering issues currently classified as High Priority. This metric helps identify the overall level of urgency within the selected workload.
spec.title: High Priority Issues

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    ROUND(
        COUNT(*)::numeric /
        COUNT(DISTINCT issue_id),
        2
    ) AS avg_skills_per_issue
FROM vw_issue_skills
WHERE customer_name IN (${customer:sqlstring})
  AND project_name IN (${project:sqlstring})
  AND status IN (${status:sqlstring})
  AND priority IN (${priority:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(created_date);

spec.description: Shows the average number of technical skills associated with each engineering issue. Higher values often indicate work requiring broader technical expertise.
spec.title: Average Skills per Issue

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    ROUND(
        COUNT(*)::numeric /
        COUNT(DISTINCT issue_id),
        2
    ) AS avg_themes_per_issue
FROM vw_issue_themes
WHERE customer_name IN (${customer:sqlstring})
  AND project_name IN (${project:sqlstring})
  AND status IN (${status:sqlstring})
  AND priority IN (${priority:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(created_date);

spec.description: Displays the average number of business or technical themes associated with each issue. Higher values may indicate work spanning multiple initiatives or functional areas.
spec.title: Average Themes per Issue

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    team_name,
    ROUND(AVG(weight),2) AS average_weight
FROM vw_issue_details
WHERE customer_name IN (${customer:sqlstring})
  AND project_name IN (${project:sqlstring})
  AND status IN (${status:sqlstring})
  AND priority IN (${priority:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(created_date)
GROUP BY team_name
ORDER BY average_weight DESC;

spec.description: Compares the average complexity of work assigned to each engineering team. Use this chart to understand which teams are responsible for the most technically challenging issues.
spec.title: Average Issue Weight by Team

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    theme_name,
    ROUND(AVG(weight), 2) AS average_weight
FROM vw_issue_themes
WHERE customer_name IN (${customer:sqlstring})
  AND project_name IN (${project:sqlstring})
  AND status IN (${status:sqlstring})
  AND priority IN (${priority:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(created_date)
GROUP BY theme_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT issue_id) >= 2
ORDER BY average_weight DESC;

spec.description: Displays the average engineering complexity for each business or technical theme. This view highlights initiatives that consistently involve higher-complexity work.
spec.title: Average Issue Weight by Theme

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    customer_name,
    COUNT(*) AS high_priority_issues
FROM vw_issue_details
WHERE priority = 'High'
  AND customer_name IN (${customer:sqlstring})
  AND project_name IN (${project:sqlstring})
  AND status IN (${status:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(created_date)
GROUP BY customer_name
ORDER BY high_priority_issues DESC;

spec.description: Shows the number of High Priority engineering issues by customer. This visualization helps identify customers requiring the most immediate engineering attention and support.
spec.title: High Priority Issues by Customer
